title: Kishen Kanhaiya
desc: Separated at birth, Kishen and Kanhaiya grow up in different worlds, one in opulent luxury, the other in poverty. Fate reunites them as they fight together to end injustice.

title: Aaj Ka Arjun
desc: A ruthless landlord exiles Bheema due to his rebellion against him. However, when his nephew is abducted, Bheema sets out to gain the support of the villagers and rescue the boy.

title: Haan Maine Bhi Pyaar Kiya
desc: Pooja divorces her husband for being unfaithful and gets a job as secretary to a film star. The two fall in love, before her ex-husband returns, and she finds herself confused between the two men.

title: Spyder
desc: Shiva, an intelligence officer, develops a phone software that helps him track those in need of help. He sets out to save the people of Hyderabad when he realises that a serial killer is on the loose.

title: Barood
desc: Jai, an honest police officer, falls in love with Neha, Mr Singhal's daughter. However, he suspects Mr Singhal to be a criminal and tries to catch him red-handed.
